content: Zero-trust architecture: verify every request as if the network is already breached
Event-driven, serverless architectures that scale to zero when idle
Federated learning: train models on-device without centralising sensitive data
Apply GitOps: treat all infrastructure and configuration as version-controlled code
Use strangler-fig pattern for zero-downtime legacy system migration
Design for observability-first: metrics, logs, and traces from day one
Implement circuit-breaker and bulkhead patterns to isolate failure domains
Deploy feature flags to decouple release from deployment and reduce rollout risk
